gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i3: Common boundary values used to exercise overflow handling. Naming them makes the intent of each near-limit calculation explicit at the call site.
ADDED i5: Round-trip the singleton through serialization...
ADDED i6: ...and confirm readResolve restored the very same instance, not a copy.
ADDED i10: (MAX / 7) + 7 weeks is more than Integer.MAX_VALUE days once multiplied by 7.
ADDED i14: 3 hours has a remainder when converted to days.
ADDED i15: Months have no fixed length in days, so the conversion is rejected.
ADDED i18: Valid ISO-8601-style strings paired with the day count they represent. Covers day-only ("PnD"), week-only ("PnW") and combined ("PnWnD") forms, each with the va
ADDED i19: Strings that are not valid {@code Days} representations: wrong units, missing the "P" prefix, units out of order, or numbers with no unit.
ADDED i23: 2019 is a common year (365 days), 2020 is a leap year (366 days).
ADDED i35: -Integer.MIN_VALUE cannot be represented as an int.
ADDED i37: |Integer.MIN_VALUE| cannot be represented as an int.
